LSJ,
Can you play 2 Kholos of the exact same kind on a vampire on
subsequent political action?

It wouldn't be contesting and it wouldn't be two of the same action
modifier on the same action.

If you can call the same Justicar on the same vampire, then why not
call the same Kholo?

Comments Welcome,
